title: Rafiq Motion Scene (RMS v1)
description: One JSON document per motion project. Positions and sizes are in grid units (8px on a 1080px short side); colours are brand tokens; time is in seconds.

brand.description: "workspace" (default) or a template id such as "dark", "light", "neon", "warm".

palette.description: This video's own colours for the brand.* tokens (surface, surface2, onSurface, muted, primary, onPrimary, accent, or any new role name you use as brand.<role>). Choose a palette for the video's concept; it overrides the workspace kit for this video only.

fonts.description: This video's own fonts by role. Any family works: the shipped ones (Alexandria, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Cairo, Tajawal, Readex Pro, Noto Kufi Arabic, Inter, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono) or any Google Fonts family by its exact name (e.g. "Rubik", "El Messiri", "Lalezar", "Amiri", "Reem Kufi", "Changa", "Almarai", "Baloo Bhaijaan 2", "Marhey", "Playfair Display", "Bebas Neue", "Poppins").

type.description: This video's own type scale, px on a 1080 short side, over the kit's (display 96, headline 64, title 44, body 32, caption 28). Vertical reels read best much bigger, e.g. display 200, headline 110, title 72, body 48, caption 36.

color.description: Any colour: a brand token (brand.primary, brand.accent, brand.onSurface, brand.muted, brand.surface, brand.surface2, brand.onPrimary), a hex colour (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa with alpha), or "transparent". Tokens keep a video on brand; hex is fine when the design needs it — the contrast check still applies.

ease.description: linear | inOut | outExpo | outBack | spring | spring(stiffness,damping) | brand

direction.description: Which way start/end point. Defaults to rtl.

margin.description: Distance of start/end/top/bottom anchors from the edge, in units. Default 8.

credit.description: Source and author, for stock images.

x.description: Offset in units toward the reading end (flips with direction).

width.description: Box width in units (text wraps inside it).

to.description: countUp: the number to count to.

shadow.description: true for a soft shadow under the layer (helps text over video), or a shadow you shape: colour, blur, offset, opacity.

important.description: Kept inside the safe area and never overlapped. Text is important unless set to false.

glow.description: A coloured glow around the layer (neon, highlights).

locked.description: Editor only: the user locked it so it isn't picked or dragged on the stage. Leave it as it is.

shape.description: 2D outline. points = a star's points, a polygon's sides, a gear's teeth, a burst's rays, a blob's seed.

radius.description: Index into the kit's radius scale (3 = full pill).

path.description: SVG path data in units, 0,0 = the box's top-left.

icon.description: set:name — find names with motion_assets action=icons. One-colour sets take the layer's `color`: tabler, ph (Phosphor; -bold, -fill, -duotone, -light, -thin variants), lucide, mdi, ri (-line / -fill), iconoir, heroicons, si (brand marks). Colour sets keep their own colours and can't go to Lottie: fluent-emoji-flat (emoji), logos (brand logos in colour), circle-flags (country flags by ISO code, e.g. circle-flags:sa).

source.description: captions: the audio or video asset the words come from.

dash.description: A dashed outline: [dash, gap] in grid units.

thickness.description: Band width of a ring or an arc, in grid units.

arc.description: An arc's span in degrees, 0 = top, clockwise (a progress ring: from 0 to 270).

pointing.description: Which way an arrow points; end = the way the line reads.

fontFamily.description: A font family for this text alone (any family, like the scene's fonts).

size.description: An exact size for this text, px on a 1080 short side, over its style's (a hero word at 260, say).

pattern.description: procedural music: warm-lofi | upbeat | cinematic | minimal | corporate

text.description: tts: what to say (needs a voice provider).

duck.description: Lower this other track while this one plays.

sidechain.description: compose: pads and chords duck under the kick (default true).

length.description: sfx: length factor (2 = twice as long and lower).

style.description: compose: a ready band in `key` at the style's tempo (or `tempo`); `parts` play on top.

gradient.description: A gradient fill. Linear runs along `angle` degrees (0 = start→end across, 90 = top→bottom); radial from the centre out.

v.description: A number, an [x, y, z], or a colour.

amount.description: Distance (rise, drop, slideIn, zoomIn, float, pulse) or degrees per second (turntable, orbit).

stagger.description: Runs on the parts one after another (words or letters of a text3d, instances, a group's children).

object3.description: One thing in a 3D scene. World units: the camera sits about 7 away; a title is about 1 tall.

fit.description: Shrinks to stay inside the frame's width.

svg.description: SVG path data, or a whole <svg> — extruded into a 3D mark.

animation.description: model: the name of an animation inside the file (default: its first).

keyframes.description: position, rotation, scale ([x,y,z] or one axis like rotation.y), opacity, color, glow, morph (particles 0→1), trim (tubes 0→1).

texture.description: An image asset wrapped on the surface — a planet's equirectangular map on a sphere or globe, a band across a ring with width.

outline.description: extrude: a ready outline (no svg needed) — heart, star, bolt, cloud, gear… width/height set its proportions.

sides.description: extrude outline: a star's points, a polygon's sides, a gear's teeth, a burst's rays.

profile.description: lathe: [radius, y] pairs from the bottom up, in sizes, turned round the y axis (a vase, a bottle, a cup).

scene3d.description: A 3D scene drawn into the layer's box. Start from a `recipe` with `params`, or build `objects` yourself; what you add goes on top of the recipe.

params.description: The recipe's settings (text, material, mood, color, colors, lines, points, data, images, asset, shape…).

n.description: A pitch ("C4", "F#3", MIDI 60), a chord ("Am7", "Fmaj7", "G/3"), or a list.

scorePart.description: An instrument with notes, or a drum with hits or steps.

steps.description: Drum: one character per 16th — x hit, X accent, . rest; repeats at its own length.

arp.description: Chords played as running notes, one every `rate` beats.

strum.description: Seconds between a chord's notes, low to high.

delay.description: An echo, bouncing left and right.

sweep.description: The filter's cutoff gliding from `from` to `to` Hz over the part (a build-up, a reveal).
